summary: E1 gate-envelope implementation is production-ready. All schema, parser, CLI, agent prompt, and fixture validations pass. No blocking issues; 2 LOW observations noted but intentional.

findings.message: datetime.fromisoformat accepts naive datetimes (no timezone), exceeding JSON Schema draft-07 'format: date-time' spec which technically allows them. Intentional leniency is acceptable for a validator.
findings.suggestion: Document in E1.2 (validate-schema subcommand) that this is intentional. No code change required.
